rulings.ruling: blocked_action_ids is an explicit keyword on _set_run_state/_exhausted rather than hidden per-run coordinator state, matching ADR 0031's 'the same kernel call'.

rulings.ruling: The unavailable-verifier outcome.reported gains action_state null because the §3 table is the binding list; the ADR prose was corrected to match.

rulings.ruling: Strict payload readers drop the reconstruction keys via one helper (without_reconstruction_keys) instead of loosening OutcomeReport (PR-06).
